requirement.statement: Eidolon workflow integration SHALL use canonical XNL/depa-flows resources, injected Eidolon roots, actor/session effect authority and native surfaces; it SHALL NOT introduce XML authoring, MCP, external agent CLI or parallel flow/runtime authority.

case.given: Ctrl or Data workflow production source
case.when: it loads or executes a definition
case.then: it SHALL use canonical depa-flows XNL loaders and Ctrl/Data runtimes
it SHALL NOT parse XML or implement a parallel scheduler

case.given: CLI or TUI constructs the workflow component
case.then: injected Eidolon roots SHALL be shared and default ownership SHALL use `.eidolon/workflows`
workflow resources SHALL remain under the injected Eidolon-owned root

case.given: a workflow node invokes agent, tool, human or Material work
case.when: the effect starts, completes or fails
case.then: Eidolon actor/session/runtime-control SHALL retain lifecycle authority and workflow facts SHALL only reference it

case.given: conversation, TUI or CLI uses workflow capability
case.when: it reads or mutates authoring/run facts
case.then: it SHALL call native component services without MCP, external agent CLI or private mutation paths
